reviewSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Subject verified unmoved at 0c174a60... mode 0444. All 21 dispatch attacks plus 12 independent attacks were run; all 33 were refuted, none landed. Every one of the 12 distinct cited path/digest pairs recomputes from live bytes, as does HEAD, the live register state matches the draft's recital clause for clause, the no-cell-edit branch excludes D-236 and is corroborated by file 08's git history, both Stage A verdicts are ACCEPT 0/0 pinned to the frozen v4 and mutually unread, and the draft's characterisation of Claude's three unlabeled observationsNotFindings strings and Codex's empty lists is byte-accurate.
